case_availability.rule: one real coupled propagation of the case with the model under test at the study's own epoch, duration and tolerances; a model whose documented native altitude range cannot express the case's own trajectory is reported unavailable for that case, and no scenario, epoch, tolerance or model is altered to make it pass

case_availability_gate.rule: a (model, case) pair the measurement reports inexpressible is recorded as a named blocked task with its reason; no scenario, epoch or tolerance is altered to make a pair available, and no other scenario is substituted for it

historical_reference.claim_limit: equivalence only over these five fixture epochs and grid points; not byte equivalence of SOLFSMY releases and not a universal model guarantee

input_set.rule: an explicitly selected input set pins every primary input by hash; the study executable verifies the same id before it measures anything, and the evidence is labelled scientific-experimental-pinned, never direct-v2

limitations: Every density, propagation and timing number in this directory is a verbatim study-executable result; run.py computes no scientific quantity.
Process-isolated benchmark children own independent caches; interprocess reuse is never counted as a hit.
A candidate configuration is propagated only after a measured accuracy stage; the selection policy and the ranking it used are recorded in the plan.

This run measured the explicitly pinned input set 'exp-solfsmy-20261011-original-pck' (manifest SHA-256 116f6bb0022c9fb4a7de13f68fbdcc7617060a232803d17659421fd052389e2f), not the historical direct-v2 baseline. Any claim it makes is scoped to those pinned bytes; the recorded reference notes: equivalence only over these five fixture epochs and grid points; not byte equivalence of SOLFSMY releases and not a universal model guarantee

2 result(s) were imported from validated existing evidence and are published in results/ with their producer hashes; an imported result never completes a planned task and is never a substitute for provider, JB2008, coupled or performance evidence.

shortlist.budget_rule: every configuration is screened once per grid setting and that one scoring answers every budget from the measured maximum; the adaptive candidate is additionally screened per target, because there the target changes the algorithm rather than the score
shortlist.coverage_rule: at least one configuration per candidate and one per interpolation axis of the interpolating candidate are always selected, so the A, B, C and D variants and the pure altitude, time and 4-D axes are never pruned away; --max-shortlist only caps the additional configurations

shortlist.holdout_rule: all four packets are required, and the selection threshold is judged on the worst of them: the stratified physical-boundary packet carries the per-point errors and the native, guard, domain and node counts that a random or local packet cannot show
shortlist.metric: maximum of all four holdout maximum_absolute_relative values of the requested rung, over every weather epoch, in percent

shortlist.refinement_rule: a family's ladder advances only while the rung in front of it was measured and missed this budget; once a rung meets it the coarser, cheaper rung is the one carried forward and no finer setting is executed
shortlist.selection_rule: a whole configuration (model, candidate, weather mode, cell_km, cell_deg, cell_s, capacity, interpolation policy and adaptive target) is selected only when all of its completed accuracy tasks published a worst-case error within the threshold and reconstructed the holdouts themselves; among those, the one with the fewest measured native calls wins, then the smallest measured construction cost, then the smallest error
shortlist.selection_source: measured accuracy and cost of this run
